components.name: DSPFilters
components.scope: RBJ low-pass, high-pass, constant-peak band-pass, notch, all-pass, peaking and low/high shelf coefficient equations only; CyDSP lifecycle, state, validation and block API are new. Chebyshev I/II pole/zero equations, bounded elliptic prototype factorization and Laguerre/Bessel root equations, adapted into preparation-only CyDSP SOS design; processing uses existing CyDSP cascades.

components.name: FFTConvolver
components.scope: Uniform partitioning and overlap-add adapted into CyDSP independent-channel/shared MIMO streaming, including progressive late jobs; uses original CyDSP FFT/complex kernels and scheduling, no upstream AudioFFT runtime.

components.name: r8brain-free-src
components.scope: Windowed-sinc and cosine window equations only; CyDSP rational streaming, phase tables, memory and lifecycle are independent; not the complete r8brain SRC algorithm.

components.name: miniaudio
components.scope: Unmodified private hardware-audio backend, built without engine, resource manager, decoders, encoders or generators; selected MIT-0 alternative.

components.name: rtmidi
components.scope: Unmodified private backend for physical MIDI input/output; nonbinding contribution request is not a license condition.

components.name: choc
components.scope: Private pinned file codecs; separately adapted WAV reader/writer preserves LIST subtype/raw metadata and validates RIFF padding/lengths. Pristine upstream headers retained byte-exact. ISC wrapper and embedded permissive codec notices retained.

components.name: signalsmith-linear
components.scope: Packed half-bin FFT reconstruction and STFT/window normalization adapted; upstream FFT implementation replaced by prepared CyDSP ComplexFft and shared VectorOps; original files retained as provenance only.

components.name: signalsmith-stretch
components.scope: Pitch/time/formant algorithm adapted into the private CyDSP engine using its prepared SIMD FFT, STFT and common public lifecycle; upstream header is provenance only.

components.name: windows-midi
components.scope: Only native Windows MIDI Services COM ABI declarations and endpoint GUIDs adapted; no service, driver, SDK binary, synthesizer or GUI imported. Original interface definitions retained for pinned provenance. Stream/Function Block identity and text bit-packing adapted into original bounded portable helpers; no WinRT implementation/runtime linked.

components.name: clap
components.scope: Pinned unmodified interface headers and minimal ABI implementation files only; original CyDSP host/export/editor adapters use private SDK types. No external plugin or GUI framework code.
